entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Is it possible to get traces in the cosmos db provider for ef core? #37615
  • RelationalCommandBuilder._commandTextBuilder should be exposed to subclasses #37611

Closed

  • dotnet-ef on Linux results in MSB3552: Resource file "**/*.resx" cannot be found #37506
    10.0.4
  • GO batch separator not recognized when block comment contains a single quote #37494
    10.0.4
  • Issue when trying to update some entities that are in a many to many relationships with a favourite child #37310
    11.0.0
  • SqlQuery generates invalid SQL with unreferenced parameter names due to parameter duplication #37409
    10.0.4
  • A simple signout button in a header doesnt work in .Net 9 Blazor Server VS2026 environment WTF!- The Fix! #37610

Created

  • Simpler null constant checks in Cosmos translator #37616

Merged

    Servicing-approved, 10.0.4

    Servicing-approved, 10.0.4
  • [release/10.0] Fix duplicate DbParameter naming uniquification #37541
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.4
